attr.title: Guitar Hero III (native)
attr.desc: A native player for Guitar Hero III's own PC data files, in pixel art and in Portuguese (GH3 3D: the same with the game's own venues drawn in 3D behind the highway): the career with its tiers, battles and encores unlocked like the game, records and stars, lead guitar or bass, four difficulties, hammer-ons, sustains and star power with the game's note-judging rules, song previews, configurable controls and options. Bring your own copy of the game's DATA folder.
attr.inst: Copy the game's DATA folder (at least PAK/, SONGS/ and MUSIC/; ZONES/ for the 3D stage) to ports/gh3/DATA/. See README.md.
